title: Iron Elevator
description: A simple elevator made of only two iron blocks, spaced between 4 and 21 blocks apart, requires no free space between them. The direction of movement is determined by the shift and jump key.
body:
Simple & Smart Elevator Data Pack

Tired of building complex redstone elevators? This data pack adds a simple, functional, and stylish iron block elevator to your Minecraft world! Just jump while standing on an iron block to go up, and sneak (shift) to go down. It's that easy!

Features:

Easy to Use: No complicated commands or redstone knowledge needed.

Smooth Teleportation: Instant, lag-free movement with a cool teleportation sound effect.

Cooldown System: Prevents spamming and adds balance.

Highly Compatible: Works seamlessly with any world or server without modifying terrain.

Customizable: Easy to adjust teleport height or block type in the function files.

How to Install:

Download the .zip file.

Place it in your world's datapacks folder.

Type /reload in-game or restart your world.

How to Use:

Place iron blocks vertically where you want the elevator shaft.

Stand on any iron block.

Jump to go up. Sneak (press Shift) to go down.

Enjoy your new vertical transportation system!

Perfect for towers, bases, mines, and modern builds. Works in Survival, Adventure, and Multiplayer!

Requirements:

Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.1 or newer.
